title: Congruent figures
explanation: Figures with the same shape and size that can be superimposed exactly.

title: SSS congruence
explanation: Three equal corresponding side lengths guarantee triangle congruence.

title: SAS congruence
explanation: Two equal sides and the included angle guarantee congruence.

title: SSA limitation
explanation: Two sides and a non-included angle do not guarantee congruence.

title: AAA limitation
explanation: Equal three angles determine shape but not size.

title: Correspondence order
explanation: The order in ΔABC≅ΔXYZ records A↔X, B↔Y, C↔Z.
